description:
Biogistry is a local-first, browser-native clinical genetics and pedigree analysis workbench. Operating 100% client-side via local storage, it ensures zero PHI server uploads, full offline access, and strict HIPAA/GDPR alignment.

It unifies 2D canvas pedigree drawing (5,000+ nodes), digital intake parsing, Bayesian carrier risk peeling, 10+ risk models (Gail, Claus, NCCN), 17+ genetics calculations, G-banding cytogenetics (ISCN), and SMART-on-FHIR R4 / GEDCOM interoperability.
name: Biogistry
